files.src/project-details-dialog.css: .project-details { display: grid; width: min(58rem, 100%); grid-template-columns: minmax(13rem, .8fr) minmax(18rem, 1.4fr); } .project-details__list { border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--kui-color-border); } @media (max-width: 44rem) { .project-details { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .project-details__list { border-inline-end: 0; border-block-end: 1px solid var(--kui-color-border); } }
